Lines with high mitochondrial mass/oxidative phosphorylation gene expression and intact apoptotic signaling (e.g., TP53 wild-type or functional) are sensitized, while lines relying on glycolysis or with strong antioxidant/detoxification programs are protected. Lines with high mitochondrial mass/oxidative phosphorylation gene expression and intact apoptotic signaling (e.g., TP53 wild-type or functional) are sensitized, while lines relying on glycolysis or with strong antioxidant/detoxification programs are protected. The observed enrichment of TP53 mutations in sensitive lines is consistent with loss of p53-mediated survival signaling under metabolic stress, but the dominant predictive feature is mitochondrial/oxidative phosphorylation dependence.
